answers.core: For this to work efficiently, I believe it needs to be built into the render pipeline and accessible in the core shader language.
answers.workaround: This could potentially be worked (but a huge hassle) around to some degree but it really becomes a huge barrier in terms of implementing certain SFX in a similar manner to other game engines.
